requirements.description: Monthly stock returns, prices, shares, exchange and SIC codes for all CRSP stocks January 1926 - December 2010 (motivates universe_all_crsp_stocks, var_r_nm, avail_returns_from_1926)
Point-in-time share/exchange codes and historical SIC for the 'all stocks in the CRSP universe' filter and NYSE-break identification (motivates universe_all_crsp_stocks, sort_decile_nyse_breaks)
Fama-French three factors plus UMD and risk-free, monthly, July 1926 onward (motivates factor_umd_validation, factor_ff3_ff4_regressions)
Delisting returns and codes for stocks leaving the sample (motivates delisting_paper_silent; paper is silent, CRSP msf.ret already folds dlret into the last month, msedelist provides the raw fields)

Annual fundamentals for tiered book-equity construction (SEQ / CEQ+PSTK / AT-LT plus TXDITC / TXDB+ITCB and PSTKR/PSTKL/PSTK), 1970-2010 for the committed FM samples (motivates var_be_shareholder_equity_tiers, var_be_deferred_taxes_tiers, var_be_preferred_tiers, var_log_bm)

Davis-Fama-French (2000) hand-collected book equity for 1927-1949 (and thin 1950s Compustat backfill) required by the paper's log(BM) control before Compustat coverage (motivates avail_dff_book_equity_precompustat)
CCM link table to merge Compustat book equity onto CRSP permnos for the FM log(BM) control
Quarterly earnings and assets for SUE (last quarterly earnings minus its four-quarter average, scaled by assets), sample January 1973 - December 2010 (motivates var_sue, avail_sue_quarterly_earnings)
Historical SIC codes for constructing the Fama-French 49 industry portfolios for Table 8 (motivates sample_other_markets_assets)
23 tradable MSCI developed-market country index total returns 1927-2010 (paper Tables 10; NOT a committed table - documented skip)

Futures prices on 31 commodities 1927-2010 (paper Table 11; NOT a committed table - documented skip; tr_ds_fut_202606 holds Refinitiv futures metadata but no verified 1927-2010 commodity price series)
Exchange-rate returns for 19 currencies 1927-2010 (paper Table 12; NOT a committed table - documented skip; comp_202601.exrt_mly is unpopulated)

blocking_issues.reason: The paper uses Davis, Fama, and French (2000) hand-collected book equity before Compustat availability (footnote 1, L155); no DFF/Moody's book-equity table exists in the catalog and standard-filter funda starts in 1970 (seq NULL for essentially all 1950-1957 rows). Without it the log(BM) control cannot be built for 1927-1949, so Table 1's Whole/Early/First/Second columns are not replicable.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Scope reduction already applied at Stage 4: T1 commits only the Late (1969-2010), Third (1969-1989), and Fourth (1990-2010) columns, which are fully covered by Compustat-era book equity. Table 9 (style momentum, sample July 1927-2010) is skipped for the same reason. All 540 committed cells remain computable; substitution logged in preparations/assumptions.md.
